description: Na₃CoO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.66 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.97 Å. Co is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.77 Å) and one longer (1.79 Å) Co-O bond length. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Co atom.
